purpose.summary: This batch program (ORCR0670) is part of the ORCA JMA (Japan Medical Association) standard medical receipt software. It performs disease-name (byomei) editing/compilation for inpatient receipt processing, reading receipt detail files (RECE62, RECE63), checking and updating patient disease name records (tbl_ptbyomei) via a database call, and writing results to output files including an error file.
purpose.domain: healthcare / medical billing (Japanese medical insurance receipt processing)

notable_features: Japanese comments encoded in latin-1 (Shift-JIS or EUC-JP garbled as latin-1)
CALL 'ORCDBMAIN' for database access (custom DB abstraction layer, not EXEC SQL)
COPY statements referencing .INC copybooks (CPRCF062.INC, CPRCF063.INC, CPJOBKANRI.INC, etc.)
COPY with REPLACING for file record aliases (RECE63W)
Multiple indexed files with DYNAMIC access mode
LINKAGE SECTION with COMMAND-PARAM for shell/program invocation
Conditional STOP RUN vs EXIT PROGRAM based on SHELLID parameter
grpsys-prefixed comment/code lines indicating group system integration points
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — uses proprietary ORCDBMAIN call interface
verdict.notes: The file is clearly production COBOL from the open-source ORCA medical receipt system developed by JMA (Japan Medical Association). Japanese text in comments is garbled due to latin-1 decoding of what is likely EUC-JP or Shift-JIS encoding. The 'grpsys' prefix on some lines appears to be a conditional compilation or group-system marker. The program uses 16 CALLs to external subprograms for DB access, job management, date conversion, and disease-name construction. Source is truncated at 16000 chars but the structure is clear.
